metadata.name: DeepL Translate
metadata.author: kanaru313
metadata.description: Translates lyrics line by line with the DeepL API. Needs your own API key (a Free key ends with :fx); the lines, and the title and artist when song context is on, are sent to DeepL.

apiKey.title: DeepL API key
apiKey.subtitle: A key ending in :fx uses the Free API (api-free.deepl.com), any other key the Pro API

formality.title: Formality
formality.subtitle: Used only for languages where DeepL supports it (for example German, French, Spanish, Japanese); other languages ignore it

options.title: More formal, if the language supports it
More informal, if the language supports it

useSongContext.title: Send the song as context
useSongContext.subtitle: Sends the title and artist as context to improve word choice; DeepL does not bill context
